artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.2
artworks.description: This is a painting of an 18th-century interior scene with figures engaged in various activities. The room is ornate, featuring detailed wallpaper and large paintings hanging on the walls. In the center, a man and a woman are seated at a small table; the woman gestures towards the man. To the left, a door opens to reveal two other figures peering into the room. Below, a small dog chews on a broken object on the floor. There are broken pieces of ceramic scattered near the table, and a jug carried by another figure. The entire piece is detailed, suggesting a narrative typical of 18th-century satirical works. This is in the style of William Hogarth, known for his moral and satirical engravings.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.3
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an interior domestic scene with various activities taking place. The image features a room with a four-poster bed, a wooden chair with clothing, framed pictures on the wall, and women engaged in conversation. One woman is using a mortar and pestle with utensils scattered on a table in front of them. In the background, men are entering the scene. Various household items like pots and jugs are placed on the floor, and the drawing emphasizes different textures and details, creating a realistic depiction of daily life.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.4
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a shoe workshop with workers engaged in various activities. The setting suggests a busy environment within a brick-walled building, resembling a cobbler's workshop from an earlier time period.

Full description: The image shows workers involved in different stages of shoe-making and fitting. In the foreground, two women are trying on shoes on a bench. Behind them, a group of onlookers in ornate clothing observe the process or wait their turn. A slogan on the wall reads "Better to Work than Stand thus." Natural light illuminates the scene through the wooden-beamed ceiling, offering a view of the outdoors.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.5
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered room with broken furniture, scattered papers, and debris. At the center, a man appears to be adjusting his collar. To his left, another man is bending over. A woman is gesturing expressively in the background. Various items are scattered around, including a tipped-over ink pot, broken objects, and a fireplace with a fire near a disheveled child. The room shows signs of wear and tear, with a damaged wall and exposed beams. Household items like dishes on a shelf and laundry hanging to dry add to the chaotic and disorderly atmosphere of the room.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.6
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling domestic scene. The image shows a group of people engaged in various activities surrounding a table. On the table, two women are involved in an activity. Surrounding them are others, including a figure watching the activity, one holding a book, and another with an attentive posture. The environment suggests a domestic setting with wooden beams on the ceiling, framed pictures on the walls, and a window on the right side. The textures of the clothing and detailed interior elements hint at a lively atmosphere of collaboration. This is in the style of William Hogarth.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.1
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered room filled with various objects and activities. The scene is set in an indoor environment and includes a cabinet with household items on the left side, a fireplace surrounded by cooking pots and tools, and a mantelpiece with a painting and other objects. People are engaged in various activities, such as adjusting the ceiling and measuring something with a compass. The room is richly decorated, reflecting a chaotic yet lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.2
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a room filled with artwork and music. The detailed interior portrays a group of people engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a man is seated at a keyboard instrument, while a group of people surrounding him is interacting. The room's walls are adorned with framed paintings, adding to the opulence of the environment. The scene conveys a sense of 18th-century elegance and decadence, with rich clothing and elaborate wigs suggesting wealth and sophistication. Each figure in the scene is active, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the gathering.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.3
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded interior space with many people engaging in revelry. Various objects can be seen throughout the room, including bottles and instruments. The scene is detailed with lush fabrics and flowing garments, giving a sense of opulence and chaos.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.4
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a busy street scene. Various characters are interacting. In the center, a group surrounds a fallen individual. On the left, a well-dressed figure watches. Buildings are in the background under a stormy sky with lightning. A person on a ladder is pouring a liquid. Another person is searching through a box. Objects and a sleeping figure are on the ground. The drawing includes detailed clothing and expressions, depicting societal tensions.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.5
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures inside an interior. The scene is detailed with various characters showing different expressions and actions. One female figure is pulling a young girl's hair as a man with a book stands nearby. Other figures in the background are engaged in their own interactions. The setting includes architectural elements like arched windows and an inscription on the wall. Two dogs are seen interacting on a platform in the lower left corner. The drawing captures a moment of commotion or ceremony.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.6
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene within a room with several men engaged in different activities. Most of the men are shown from the waist up. They are seated or standing around tables, raising their arms, holding objects, such as a lantern or a piece of paper. The men have a variety of expressions and hairstyles typical of the period, with many wearing wigs or styled hair. They are dressed in historical clothing like suits with long coats, waistcoats, and knee-length socks detailed with buttons and lace. Some wear hats, including tricorn styles. The men hold various objects like a pen, a lantern, cards, and possible gambling counters. The room has sconces on the walls, a man with a staff in the background, and a caged area that may be a service counter. A dog is also present in the scene.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.7
artworks.description: The engraving depicts multiple figures in an interior setting. In the center, a woman reclines towards the left on a wooden bench or pew. Beside her, another woman assists a child. A child with curly hair sits nearby, interacting with the scene. To the right, a man gestures while a woman engages him. On the far right, figures engage in conversation. Household objects clutter the scene, with a wall and window in the background.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.8
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an asylum scene depicting the interior of a crowded room with various figures engaged in chaotic and disturbing activities. The image shows individuals in different states of distress and behavior that suggest mental instability. The central figure is shirtless and restrained, being attended to by a woman and an older man, possibly a physician. The background contains numerous figures engaging in erratic behavior; one individual is gesturing with exaggerated motions, while another plays a musical instrument. Two women are seen whispering and fanning themselves on the right. A small dog barks or is excited at the bottom center of the scene. The use of detailed linework and shading brings a sense of depth and structure to the image, emphasizing the confinement and tumultuous atmosphere within this enclosed space.

artworks.title: The First Stage of Cruelty
artworks.description: This is a drawing of scenes of animal cruelty. The scene is set in a street with buildings in the background, featuring a church steeple and a rooftop weather vane. The drawing depicts individuals engaging in and witnessing activities of animal cruelty. In the foreground, a figure with a covered face is attempting to hang a cat suspended from a lamppost, while another reaches out anxiously. Below them, several individuals appear to be harming dogs. One person is inserting an arrow into the ground behind one of the animals. Another figure on the left is tormenting a dog with a large stick, while on the ground, a man is harming another dog and a snake. Some individuals are watching and some appear to be participating in these acts with enjoyment. The architecture suggests an urban environment, with brickwork and street lamps providing context. The overall mood is chaotic and distressing, reflecting inhumanity and indifference towards suffering.

artworks.title: The Second Stage of Cruelty
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy street scene showing instances of animal cruelty. A horse has fallen while pulling a cart, being beaten by one figure and observed by another. Nearby, sheep seem agitated as a figure with a weapon adds to the unrest. In the background, chaos ensues with animals running wild and people acting recklessly. The street's architecture serves as a frame for the scene, illustrating disorderly life. The drawing includes detailed and whimsical yet grim elements hinting at satirical commentary.

artworks.title: Cruelty in Perfection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures gathered around a building and a person on the ground. The setting is outdoors at night, with a clock tower in the background displaying the time as 1:05. Some figures are holding objects, such as pitchforks and lanterns. A paper, a lantern, and a chest are on the ground. A crescent moon and an owl are visible in the sky. The title "CRUELTY IN PERFECTION" is written at the top.

artworks.title: The Reward of Cruelty
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dissection scene with an audience looking on. The full-description reveals a detailed anatomical dissection taking place in a circular room filled with seated observers. In the center lies a cadaver on a table with various figures, some in academic garb, actively participating in the autopsy. The room is decorated with skeletons and anatomical signs, underscoring the nature of the activity. A dog is beneath the table. A cauldron with skulls and bones beside a smoking fire is present. The detailed lines and shading create depth, making it a vivid portrayal of anatomical exploration.

artworks.title: Noon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy street scene at noon. Various activities are shown outside a church and nearby buildings. Individuals are talking, eating, and moving around a table in front of a shop. The scene features a diverse group of characters and detailed architecture, including tall buildings and a church steeple in the background. The clothing, expressions, and body language of the figures reflect social realism. The drawing depicts everyday life with humor and criticism of societal behavior.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an evening street scene in a village or small town. The drawing depicts a central figure standing in front of a wooden fence, holding what appears to be a small child or bundle in her arms, with a dog at her feet and cattle in the background. The setting is outdoor, with a large sky dominating the upper half of the image, filled with softly rendered clouds. To the left, there is a building with a sign that reads "Salletus Welder". To the right, the side of another building is visible, with a hanging sign featuring a portrait. More buildings and rolling hills can be seen in the background. The detailed line work and shading give the drawing a realistic and textured appearance.

artworks.title: Night
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a night street scene. The image shows an urban street with various activities happening. On the left, a building with a window is seen pouring a liquid, alongside hanging signage. In the foreground, two figures carry a lantern, with a group of people behind them engaged in activities near a fire. The architecture of the buildings adds to the setting, with signboards hanging from them. The sky is dark with swirling clouds above. The drawing captures the liveliness of a nighttime street, showcasing urban life.

artworks.title: The Fellow 'Prentices at Their Looms
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an industrious workshop with weaving looms being operated. The image shows a workshop interior with wooden looms, mechanical parts, and weaving tools. The engraving technique highlights the texture of the wooden beams and metal gears. A sign labeled "The Prentice Guide" and other notices are visible on the walls. The workshop appears busy and organized, indicative of productive labor.

artworks.title: The Industrious 'Prentice performing the Dutyof a Christian
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of several individuals in a church-like setting. A young apprentice and a woman are in focus in the foreground. The young man stands in a wooden pew with a book in his hands. His facial features are detailed with a concentrated expression, shoulder-length curly hair, and formal 18th-century attire. The woman wears a bonnet and a patterned dress, holding a book. The background includes a church interior with high vaulted ceilings, arches, and a large organ, with people seated or listening to a service.
